queries.instruction: The easy, figure-elongating construction of the NYDJ Marilyn Straight Women's Pull-On Jeans pairs well with everything, thanks to a flattering waist and a versatile, straight-leg fit. Lift Tuck Technology uses a proprietary slimming panel with a patented crisscross design to shape and support your curves for an always-sleek silhouette, so you can look, feel and wear one size smaller. Finished with back pockets and a pull-on waistband for greater comfort. MATERIAL: 72% Cotton, 20% Lyocell, 5% Elastomultiester, 3% Elastane.SIZING: Inseam: 32", Front Rise: 9.75", Leg Opening: 16". Select one size smaller for the perfect fit. NYDJ, formally known as Not Your Daughter's Jeans, creates jeans for every body: all shapes, all sizes, and all ages. Founded in 2003, NYDJ set out to design premium stretch jeans with a fabulous fit that makes every woman feel comfortable and confident—like her best self. All NYDJ jeans are made with Lift Tuck Technology, a proprietary slimming panel with a patented crisscross design to flatten in the front and curve-contouring construction to flatter curves in the back. Headquartered in Los Angeles and inspired by California style and the latest denim trends, NYDJ is always working to bring you the most innovative denim technologies as well as the chicest non-denim pants and pair-perfect tops.
